simulator.note: As the C3505 family (2026-10-12, run_dump_t760i_app_starts.py): the boot ROM's step into the boot SRAM, the bootloader waits for bit 8 of 0xB8000300, unpacks the application and starts it; the application moves its exception vectors (EBase 0x80002000) and starts the SEE co-processor's program at 0xA6000200 on the second core (see.SeeCore; it moves its own, EBase 0x86002000), prints its banner and attaches its drivers through remote calls with the newer chips' doorbells (56 answered and 54 of the SEE's by ~64 M instructions); its ATBM7812 demodulator answers its chip ID 0xA8 at I2C 0x40 (demods.py, the sidecar's demodModel; without it the driver retried its power-on init until ~188 M), and it opens its database and runs on (240 M instructions checked, the two answering each other throughout).  Its SEE program keeps a FIFO of the chip's random numbers, which drops a result equal to one of the last five: with the generator's registers as plain memory its TRNG task never filled the FIFO and never slept, and once a display task of the SEE's slept inside a critical section (~190-198 M) nothing else ran -- see.Trng.  Its screen (2026-10-13, run_dump_t760i_capture_screen.py): the first-install wizard "Welcome" (region Poland, English, 720p_60, "OK (10 sec)" counting down) at ~105 M, then its automatic channel search "Auto Scan" (177.5 MHz on), through the newer display engine's layer at 0xB8006900 -- an ARGB8888 bitmap of 1280 x 720 set up through register lists in RAM (gma_capture.de_layers).

desc: Ferguson Ariva T760i firmware V1.5B4, the manufacturer's USB update image from Ferguson's download area (Ferguson_T760i_V1.5B4-14092021.zip).

Despite the .abs name it is a complete flash image: the ALi chunk chain from offset 0 -- HATB1 0x000000 (66019-01047, 2021-9-14), HDCPKey 0x02FE00 (1.0.0, 2016-7-14), maincode 0x030000 (V1.5B4, 2021-9-14), seecode 0x480000 (V1.5B4, 2021-9-14), radioback 0x5F0000 (1.0.0, 2016-7-14), seeback 0x60FF80 (1.0.0, 2016-7-14), T760i 0x620000 (1.0.0, 2016-7-14), data 0x63FF80 (1.0.0, 2016-7-14), defaultdb 0x690000 (1.0.0, 2016-12-8), userdb 0x6AFF80 (1.0.0, 2021-9-14); the maincode's CRC-32/MPEG-2 is intact.  Banners in its LZMA streams: Libcore version 17.15.0@SDK4.0ia.17.15_20171115; Libcore version 1.1.5a@SDK_20111126.

Like the T750i it has a "seecode" chunk (the SEE co-processor's code, Libcore 1.1.5a@SDK_20111126); the maincode's Libcore is 17.15.0@SDK4.0ia.17.15_20171115.  The chip is not an M3821: the C3505 is a later ALi generation (a DVB-S2 SoC; here the external AltoBeam ATBM7812 receives DVB-T2), which the simulator runs as chips/c3505.py: the M3821's boot-ROM path with the chip ID 0x3505.
Changelog (changelog.txt, PL / EN): V1.5B4-14092021 -- YouPorn hidden by the "parental lock" function; improved PVR screen keyboard.
